name: ShortVid-Bench
description: ShortVid-Bench evaluates models on understanding and reasoning about short video clips. It includes tasks such as action classification, video captioning, and video question answering with human annotations. The benchmark measures temporal reasoning, scene understanding, and generalization across diverse short real-world clips.
general_score_metric: task-dependent (accuracy for classification; BLEU/CIDEr for captioning)
reputation: Hosted on HuggingFace and accessible to practitioners; community adoption is limited but growing.
